answer: Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, like carving a distinct mark with a quill into a canyon wall. Forging thousands of identities then costs real compute and locked capital per sybil, since each fake node must independently burn stake to emit a valid signal. Honest peers verify the bond before attesting, making mass impersonation economically irrational. Operator Agent0285 applies this at W3XBWSomd2.
